editor.skill_help.parameter_help.text_10: GUID of the numeric card template to match, not a prefab string or runtime entity ID. Multiple copies with the same card number can satisfy the condition simultaneously.
editor.skill_help.parameter_help.text_13: Compare the current value read with the value below: Equal, LessOrEqual, GreaterOrEqual; this judgment does not modify the compared attribute.
editor.skill_help.parameter_help.text_8: Select the native component to check if it has/missing; not giving the object this ability. PlaysFaceDown and FaceDown have different meanings; equivalent range of terrain check and ability check also need another verification.
block.AdjacentLaneQuery.title: 🔵 Range: Adjacent lane (origin)
block.AdjacentLaneQuery.param.Side.title: Side
editor.skill_help.block.adjacent_lane_qu: Vanilla 82 Dance Poppy selects adjacent lane; 251 Barrel Zombie leaves Imps on adjacent lane.

Based on the leftmost/rightmost CombatOrderIndex in the base position list, then one grid outward, and direction selected by Side; does not include the base lane. Position readable as LaneElement or InLimbo retained list, cannot be inferred by screen coordinates or entity ID adjacency.
Query slot; candidates must have Lane, base selected by OriginEntityType as Self/Source/Target.
Matches lane entities adjacent to the selected base entity.
editor.skill_help.parameter.adjacent_lan: Select Self itself, Source source, or Target target that provides the reference position. The candidate is still a lane entity; this parameter does not change the actual target or source in the context.
block.AlwaysMatchesQuery.title: 🔵 Query: Always matches
editor.skill_help.block.always_matches_q: Complete generation recipe for Vanilla 180 Crazy Chemist, 402 Gift Delivery Zombie.
It will not generate targets, fill missing slots, or make the entire skill automatically valid; other objects and state restrictions in the original recipe remain.
Applicable to query slot; still needs to be provided by outer components.
No filtering conditions are added; this query always returns matches.
block.AttackComparisonQuery.title: 🔵 Query: Attack comparison
editor.skill_help.block.attack_compariso: Vanilla 26 Shockwave Strike uses attack ≤4; 92 Pineapple uses attack ≤0.

Original directly calls Attack.CalculateAttack, uses 0 if Attack component is missing, needs to limit object type separately; not directly equivalent to the final attack behavior after attack override.
Query slot; use equal, less than or equal, or greater than or equal comparison.
Compare the modifiable attack value of candidate attack components with the specified value.
editor.skill_help.parameter_help.text_14: The comparison threshold for attack value, not setting attack to this value; the native read of the Attack component can modify the value, and the final attack behavior is settled separately.
block.BehindSameLaneQuery.title: 🔵 Range: Behind in same lane
editor.skill_help.block.behind_same_lane: Vanilla 114 Torchwood Stake enhances the pea behind it; 411 Red Needle Flower checks the back row to meet conditions, with differences between original and native values retained.

First require that the lane contains Self, then compare candidates that are not of Self's faction in the front row. It is not a comparison of the front and back between any two objects; it will not automatically exclude Self or enemy units, and the original faction conditions must be retained.
Query slot; original reads the position from the first lane element in the candidate lane.
Original used to form filtering related to the back row of the same lane.
block.BlockMeterValueQuery.title: 🔵 Query: Block meter comparison
editor.skill_help.block.block_meter_valu: 458 Martian Flytrap original threshold 10; 630 Cursed Boulder Zombie has 10/20 branches; 685 Monkey Smuggler original threshold 10.

False when SuperBlocker is missing; the field is an internal integer, and the threshold 10 cannot be directly marked as 10 interface grids or changed by name. Pending verification: UI grid conversion, random block growth, MeterMax and complete boundaries of special modes still pending verification.
Query slot, usually targeting players/heroes; can be used in PlayerInfoCondition or original target filters.
Read the internal block meter value of SuperBlocker.MeterValue, then compare it with the threshold.
editor.skill_help.parameter.block_meter_: Compare the candidate MeterValue as the left value with Equal/<=/>=.
Internal meter threshold. The original example was related to stolen grid numbers, but this batch has not verified the complete UI conversion and slot upper limit.
block.CardGuidQuery.title: 🔵 Query: Card GUID match
block.CardGuidQuery.param.Guid.title: Card GUID
Vanilla 65 checks Guid=65; 110 Copy Pineapple checks Guid=110.
Card template ID, prefab string GUID, and runtime entity ID are different identities; this query will not create cards, rename, or restrict to a specific copy instance.
Query slot; compare candidate Card.Guid with parameter Guid.
Match the card with the specified numeric card GUID.
block.category.CompositeQuery.title: 🔗 Composite queries
block.category.Condition.title: Root conditions
block.category.Filter.title: 🟡 Filters
block.category.Query.title: 🔵 Queries
block.category.TargetSelector.title: 🟠 Targets
block.CompositeAllQuery.title: 🔗 All conditions [AND]
editor.skill_help.block.composite_all_qu: Original 1 Avocado simultaneously limits itself and the death effect conditions; another place simultaneously limits the same lane, zombies, and optional selection.
Native empty list returns true, but it does not mean the object is valid or the skill is complete; conditions such as survival, faction, and optional selection still need to be explicitly listed.
Query slot; sub-queries are placed in the queries list.
Only when each sub-query matches does the whole match (all conditions met).
block.CompositeAnyQuery.title: 🔗 Any condition [OR]
editor.skill_help.block.composite_any_qu: Original 3 Conga Zombie and 12 Swing Plumber allow matching plant creatures or plant heroes.
Native empty list returns false; alternative conditions can still include All combinations, but you cannot flatten all conditions and change the original card's meaning.
Query slot; each alternative condition is placed in the queries list.
At least one sub-query matches, and the whole matches (any condition met).
block.DamageTakenComparisonQuery.title: 🔵 Query: Damage taken comparison
editor.skill_help.block.damage_taken_com: 22 Medical Zombie, 46 Second Best Corn Dog, etc. Check CurrentDamage >= 1 to avoid healing targets with no damage taken.

Not the damage amount from the last damage event, nor the total damage taken throughout the game; healing and attribute changes can modify CurrentDamage. False when there is no Health, and not compared to 0. To be verified: combinations of all healing, attribute modifications, transformations, and damage redirection on this field are not executed; the outer layer still needs to select the correct target.
Query slot; original healing target queries are typically combined with faction, survival, and healable conditions.
Read the candidate Health.CurrentDamage field for damage already taken, and compare it with the threshold.
editor.skill_help.parameter.damage_taken: Use Health.CurrentDamage as left value for Equal/<=/>= comparison.
Current damage field threshold; not the minimum value of this damage event.
block.DrawnCardQuery.title: 🔵 Object: Drawn card
editor.skill_help.block.drawn_card_query: Vanilla 449 Cucumber Captain, 501 Wormhole Guard put the cost reduction effect of creating hand cards on the corresponding card.
This is an instance ID of an event record, not the card template Card.Guid, cannot match all similar cards by name; needs the current event to provide this value, missing key defaults to -1.
Query slot; read EffectData key 6, then compare candidate Entity.Id.
Matches the card entity recorded in the current context DrawnCardId.
block.FighterQuery.title: 🔵 Query: Is a fighter
editor.skill_help.block.fighter_query.ex: Vanilla 53 Rotting Clinger, 65 Deep Sea Giant's full trigger/target filtering uses this condition.
editor.skill_help.block.fighter_query.li: Will not automatically check for survival, activity, presence on field, or selectable; retain the original recipe's corresponding condition for whichever is needed, cannot remove other filters due to the 'Fighter' tag.
editor.skill_help.block.fighter_query.pl: Query slot; native condition is HasHealth and not HasPlayer.
editor.skill_help.block.fighter_query.us: Check if the candidate has a Health component and is not a player entity.
block.HasComponentQuery.title: 🔵 Query: Has component
editor.skill_help.block.has_component_qu: Original cards of rank 8 query Aquatic, 265 queries DamageImmunity; 46/155 use NotQuery to wrap Unhealable to exclude those that cannot be healed.

OriginalGetComponent searches by real Type equality. Check if the list of active abilities is non-empty for granting abilities; do not treat AbilityValue of 0 as disabled. Check that the ability is not equal to the granted ability. FaceDown current cover state differs from PlaysFaceDown play style. Pending verification: only covers 19 registered choices in the table and the original card; the entire process of loading unknown Types and clearing ability counts has not been verified.
Allow Query slots; specific candidates are determined by outer targets, Finder, or card pools, and will not automatically limit to self, opponent, or on-field entities.
Check the specified native component on the candidate entity. Regular components require existence; GrantableAbility subclasses also require the ability to be currently active.
editor.skill_help.parameter.has_componen: Must be a valid native component type. Empty default value has not selected a component, not matching all objects; invalid type loading/runtime behavior not proven in this batch.
block.HasEnvironmentComponent.title: 🔵 Query: Is environment
editor.skill_help.block.has_environment_: 339 and 43 other real queries use this fixed type.

It matches environment entities, but does not indicate that a unit is in an environment, nor does it determine if a lane exists; the latter two relationships are handled by other queries. Pending verification: the rules for environment positions, replacements, and area effects cannot be derived solely from this marker.
Check if the candidate entity has the Environment environment card marker.
block.HasFaceDownComponent.title: 🔵 Query: Is face-down / gravestone
editor.skill_help.block.has_face_down_co: 9 original queries; original 476 first checks the same lane, then uses the face-down state to assist in determining the lane.

This is the current state, not a permanent PlaysFaceDown play style, nor granting a grave or executing a reveal. Pending verification: the timing of writing/removing the face-down state and the order of all reveals are not covered by this query.
Check if the candidate currently has the FaceDown cover state marker.
editor.skill_help.block.has_highground_t: 9 original queries use the high ground component; the original complete query position is retained.

This is a terrain entity base check, not automatically indicating the candidate unit is on high ground; cannot be mixed with OnTerrain directly. Pending review: unit-to-route relationship and high ground exclusive effects depend on external conditions.
Check if the candidate entity has the HighgroundTerrain high ground tag.
block.HasLaneComponent.title: 🔵 Query: Is a lane
editor.skill_help.block.has_lane_compone: 27 Take You Fly and original groups separately select route targets and moved units.

Not 'this unit is on a certain route'; unit position uses LaneElement and another position query. Will not automatically traverse units on the route. Pending review: specific route vacancies, factions, and placement rules are still determined by external original formulas.
Query slot, fixed ComponentType=Lane; commonly used for route Finder or Primary/SecondaryTarget.
Check if the candidate entity is a route entity with a Lane component.
block.HasPlantsComponent.title: 🔵 Query: Is plant
editor.skill_help.block.has_plants_compo: Real 361 place; original 3 complete queries continue to combine other conditions as needed.

Does not automatically indicate alive, in play, or selectable plant units; plant heroes can also be paired with Player judgment. Pending review: do not expand faction checks to all plant unit qualifications.
Check if the candidate has the Plants faction tag.
block.HasPlayerComponent.title: 🔵 Query: Is hero/player
editor.skill_help.block.has_player_compo: 22 Medical Zombie and original healing target queries combine Player and faction conditions.

Player does not distinguish between plants/zombies, self/opponent, or current actor; needs Faction or context query. Pending verification: number of players in any special mode and player role mapping has not been validated.
Check if the candidate is a player/hero entity with a Player component.
block.HasSuperpowerComponent.title: 🔵 Query: Is superpower
editor.skill_help.block.has_superpower_c: 57 and 90 instances originally used Superpower; retain outer positive/negative and card pool conditions.

Not 'has any skill', nor checking if a hero has equipped a certain ability. It is only excluded by Superpower cards when wrapped in NotQuery. Pending verification: whether it can be drawn or created still depends on outer card pool and available card type conditions.
Query slot, fixed ComponentType=Superpower; can participate in card pool filtering.
Check if the candidate has a Superpower hero's superpower card mark.
block.HasUnhealableComponent.title: 🔵 Query: Unhealable
editor.skill_help.block.has_unhealable_c: 46 the second corn roll in history and 155 fountain's healing target are wrapped in NotQuery, total of 4 instances.

Unhealable inherits GrantableAbility, must be IsActive; this item itself is a positive check. The original healing formula uses NotQuery to turn it into excluding those who cannot be healed, and should not implicitly add negation within shortcut items. Pending verification: cannot infer complete healing eligibility or ability cleanup process from queries.
Check if the candidate's Unhealable unhealable ability is currently active.
block.HasWaterTerrainComponent.title: 🔵 Query: Water terrain
editor.skill_help.block.has_water_terrai: Finder of 547 high platform diving zombies requires both WaterTerrain and Lane, then judges if the lane is placeable.

Units will not automatically move from one unit to another; check the water lane entities where the unit is located using OnTerrain and verified positional relationships. Pending verification: terrain markers do not mean any unit can be placed; placement rules are checked separately.
Query slot, fixed ComponentType=WaterTerrain; original example and Lane together find water lane entities.
Check if the candidate entity has the WaterTerrain water lane terrain marker.
block.HasZombiesComponent.title: 🔵 Query: Is zombie
editor.skill_help.block.has_zombies_comp: Actual 385 locations; contract retains specific original groups, not rewriting 'Zombie Camp' as 'Field Zombies Units' universally.

Camp markers do not automatically exclude Zombie Heroes, card type databases, or other entities with the same marker; to find units, Fighter or original recipe target qualifications must be separately assigned. Pending verification: units, positions, and target qualifications outside the entity marker are decided by external queries.
Query slot, equivalent to fixed ComponentType=Zombies HasComponentQuery.
Check if the candidate has the Zombies camp marker.
block.HealthComparisonQuery.title: 🔵 Query: Health comparison
editor.skill_help.block.health_compariso: Native 0x2258B20 calls current health CalculateHealth; there is no original card instance in this batch.

Current health is not maximum health. No instances of this type were observed in the frozen 650 card; this explanation is based solely on native static references, without additional original card examples or tested effects.
Query slot; read Health.CalculateHealth, then compare based on the selected comparison operator.
Compare the current health of the candidate with the specified value.
editor.skill_help.parameter_help.text_15: The comparison threshold for current health, not health maximum or healing amount; this type's original 650 card has not observed an instance, only native static basis.
block.InAdjacentLaneQuery.title: 🔵 Range: In adjacent lane
editor.skill_help.block.in_adjacent_lane: Original 66 Zombot 1000, 79 Steelwood Orchid's adjacent lane object filtering.

Different from AdjacentLane, this matches objects on the lane rather than lane entities. Judged by Self position range outer grid and Side; if there is one adjacent position among multiple candidates, it is considered; does not automatically include same lane, limited faction, or exclude self.
Query slot; candidates must have LaneElement, with fixed base as Self's position list.
Matches candidates on the lane adjacent to Self.
block.InEnvironmentQuery.title: 🔵 Range: On an environment
editor.skill_help.block.in_environment_q: Complete recipe for original 414 Tree Lantern, 428 Invasive Species gaining attributes in Environment.
It is not the selected environment card itself, nor does it specify environment faction or terrain type; used separately from OnTerrain terrain query and SameLane lane entity query.
Query slot; candidates must have LaneElement, with at least one of their lanes having environment.
Check if the lane of the candidate has environment.
block.InHandQuery.title: 🔵 Range: In hand
editor.skill_help.block.in_hand_query.ex: Recipe for original 123 Thriving Pot, 181 Magic Zombie triggering in hand.
editor.skill_help.block.in_hand_query.li: Check only the position structure, without automatically limiting to your own cards, a certain faction, or a specific type; not an effect that moves cards on the field back to hand.
editor.skill_help.block.in_hand_query.pl: Query slot; can be placed in applicable positions for self status or target filtering.
editor.skill_help.block.in_hand_query.us: Check if the candidate has the HandElement hand card position component.
block.InLaneAdjacentToLaneQuery.title: 🔵 Range: Lane adjacent to lane
editor.skill_help.block.in_lane_adjacent: Original 102 Cherry Bomb, 430 Magma Pomegranate deals damage to adjacent zombies around the target lane.

The base is the current target lane, not Self or the target unit; Side determines the left/right adjacent in the native combat order. Candidate selection, target lane selection, and final effect are separately configured, and should not be mixed with other adjacent queries by name.
Query slot; the candidate must have a LaneElement, and the context TargetId must point to a Lane entity.
Match candidates located in adjacent positions to the current target lane.
block.InLaneQuery.title: 🔵 Range: In a lane
editor.skill_help.block.in_lane_query.ex: Original 109 Strongberry Corporal, 134 Frost Pumpkin Recipe area filtering.
editor.skill_help.block.in_lane_query.li: Not equal to judgment of being alive, active, or selectable; also does not specify which lane, and is different from SameLane which matches lane entities.
editor.skill_help.block.in_lane_query.pl: Query slot; check if the candidate has a lane position.
editor.skill_help.block.in_lane_query.us: Check if the candidate's LaneElement position list is not empty.
block.InLaneSameAsLaneQuery.title: 🔵 Range: Same lane index
editor.skill_help.block.in_lane_same_as_: Original 102 Cherry Bomb, 261 Swelling Mushroom target lane damage recipe.

Context target must have a Lane component; it's not about using the target unit's lane as an implicit reference. It's also not equivalent to the SameLaneQuery's Self lane check, and faction, alive, and selectable status still need to be separately configured.
Query slot; candidate LaneElement.LaneIds must include the entity ID of the context target's lane.
Match candidates located on the current target lane.
block.InOneTimeEffectZoneQuery.title: 🔵 Range: One-time effect zone
editor.skill_help.block.in_one_time_effe: This query appears in the complete ability recipe of the original 247 Poison Imp.
This is a judgment of the entity's location area, not a limit on the number of times a skill triggers, such as "once" or "once per round".
Query slot; native reading of OneTimeEffectZoneElement.
Check if the candidate's one-time effect zone location list is non-empty.
block.InSameLaneQuery.title: 🔵 Range: In same lane
editor.skill_help.block.in_same_lane_que: Original 1 Avocado's post-death filtering of zombies on the same lane; complete recipe of 66 Zombie Robot 1000.

Location comes from LaneElement, or the transitional state InLimbo's retained location; it requires a valid context. It judges if two entities share a location, which is different from SameLaneQuery that only matches entities on the lane.
Query slot; the reference can be optionally Self, Source, or Target.
Check if the candidate's location list intersects with the selected reference entity's location list.
block.InUnopposedLaneQuery.title: 🔵 Query: Unopposed lane
editor.skill_help.block.in_unopposed_lan: Original version 71 Sea Otter Rider, 99 Poison Vine's counter hero related complete recipe.

Determine based on the owner's selection; the original uses the total number of units on this lane minus the number of units owned by the player; it is not the entire lane being empty, nor does it automatically use Self or a fixed faction as a reference. For multiple positions, only one needs to meet the condition; the environment itself is not equivalent to the opponent's units.
Query slot; read candidate LaneElement and Owner.PlayerId.
Check that at least one lane where the candidate is located has no units from other players.
block.IsActiveQuery.title: 🔵 Query: Is active
Used in filtering or counting complete subtrees by the original 188 Power Punch and 639 Tomato Laborer.
Activity, survival, and being selectable on the field are not the same condition; you cannot remove one just because you add another.
Query slot; retain the original formula's parallel survival and object type conditions.
Filter entities based on the engine's active state.
block.IsAliveQuery.title: 🔵 Query: Is alive
editor.skill_help.block.is_alive_query.e: The original 2 Chimney Worker Zombie and 3 Conga Zombie's trigger target filtering includes this condition.
editor.skill_help.block.is_alive_query.l: Do not simplify it to just comparing the life numbers on the card face; the original also checks status. It also does not automatically replace IsActive or selectable conditions.
editor.skill_help.block.is_alive_query.p: Query slot, often combined with SelfQuery, faction, and other status conditions.
editor.skill_help.block.is_alive_query.u: Filter entities based on the engine's survival condition.
editor.original_blocks.supplement.item_5: Matches a candidate entity whose native lethal damage list contains a killer matching Query. The subquery checks the killer, while the candidate remains the victim. Often used with death or damage events.
editor.original_blocks.supplement.item_6: Vanilla cards 64, 255, 490, 491, 495, 568, 615, and 638. KilledByQuery.Matches 0x2256024, HasMatchingKiller 0x22560A8, IsMatchkingKiller 0x2256224.
Cards like 64, 255, and 490 in the original use this query, with sub-conditions including self or race judgment.
Subquery checks the source of lethal damage. Use this with actual death or damage events, using the object provided by the event.
Add it to the query slots for filtering conditions or targets, or place it inside an AND or OR subquery.
Filter the killed entities by the source of the kill.
block.LacksComponentQuery.title: 🔵 Query: Lacks component
editor.skill_help.block.lacks_component_: 253, 300, 301 have Lacks WaterTerrain; FaceDown and MarkedForDeath also have real negative instances.

This is a native Lacks path negation check, not any component with a name containing a certain word. The original WaterTerrain negative condition checks the candidate entity, and cannot automatically be interpreted as the unit's route not being a water route. Pending verification: This frozen original card does not have an instance of Lacks GrantableAbility; this branch is confirmed by native disassembly, and any combination with invalid Type behavior remains untested.
Allows Query slots; the outer query still determines the entity scope.
Applies when the ordinary component does not exist; if the specified is a GrantableAbility subclass, it applies when it does not exist or is currently not active.
editor.skill_help.parameter.lacks_compon: To exclude the real native component type; fixed default FaceDown does not represent all old conditions changed to cover judgment.
block.LaneOfIndexQuery.title: 🔵 Range: Lane by index
editor.skill_help.block.lane_of_index_qu: Original 25 Precision Bombardment uses LaneIndex=2; 265 Missile Barrage has lane index configuration.
LaneIndex is compared with CombatOrderIndex, not the lane entity ID, nor does it create new lanes. Original mid-lane example index is 2, and input is not treated as a 1-based interface number.
Query slot; candidates must have a Lane component.
Matches lanes with combat order index equal to the specified value.
editor.skill_help.parameter_help.text_11: Reference for comparing positions: Self (itself), Source (current context source), Target (current context target). Not changing the card's tribe or forcing a new target.
editor.skill_help.parameter_help.text_12: CombatOrderIndex of the lane; in the original version, precise strike to the middle lane is 2. This native index is not the lane number starting from 1 on the interface, nor is it the lane entity ID.
editor.original_blocks.supplement.item_8: Matches a lane that currently has an Environment whose entity satisfies Query. The query checks the Environment itself. Vanilla card 683 uses this to find lanes with Environments.
editor.original_blocks.supplement.item_9: PrimaryTargetFilter.Query in an ability group on vanilla card 683. Lane.EnvironmentId is passed to the nested Query.Matches, RVA 0x225643C.
editor.skill_help.block.lane_with_matchi: Do not consider lanes, environments, and units on lanes as the same object.
Place into query slots that allow querying, Query specifies environment conditions.
Filter lanes based on matching environment conditions.
editor.original_blocks.supplement.item_1: Filter lanes that contain a unit matching Query. The child condition tests units in a lane and the outer candidate remains the lane. Environment queries are separate. The original uses this for lanes containing Gravestones, Zombies, and similar targets.
Original cards 188, 218, 476, and 639. LaneWithMatchingFighterQuery.Matches at 0x2256644 inherits EntityQuery and holds a Query.
editor.skill_help.block.lane_with_matchi: Preserve essential filters such as survival, active status, and face-down status from the original recipe; not an alias for any "same lane" condition.
Place into an allowed query slot; Query limits the conditions of entities.
Filter lanes based on matching entities on the road.
block.LastLaneOfSelfQuery.title: 🔵 Range: Self's last lane
editor.skill_help.block.last_lane_of_sel: In the original 631 Hot Air Balloon machine, after moving, it leaves a random zombie at the original position.
Not reading candidate historical positions, nor always reading the current lane; this query does not handle updating LastLane records, its update time and lifecycle must be verified separately.
Query slot; read SelfId entity's LastLane.LaneId and compare with candidate entity ID.
Match the previous lane ID of the Self record.
block.NotQuery.title: 🔗 Negation (NOT)
editor.skill_help.block.not_query.exampl: Original 20 Growth Mushroom uses Not(SelfQuery) to exclude itself; 46 Corn on the Wall excludes untreatable targets.
editor.skill_help.block.not_query.limits: An empty native Query will enter an exception path, not default match; negating one condition does not automatically fill in other validity conditions.
editor.skill_help.block.not_query.placem: Query slot; Query must be a valid query.
editor.skill_help.block.not_query.usage: Invert the matching result of the internal Query.
block.OncePerGameCondition.title: 🟣 Limit: Once per game
editor.skill_help.block.once_per_game_co: Original 395/396 etc. BoardAbility definitions total 13; these definitions have no available local card names/introductions, do not fabricate the original card text.

This evaluator only reads and inverts this flag, does not record used, clear the flag or independently calculate usage count here. Cannot promise multiple groups to be independent or multiple related groups to share based on the name. Pending verification: flag writing/reset, AbilityGroup sharing and replication/alteration's full per-game scope needs independent system verification; original engine has not been tested.
Skill group root Condition; no parameters, no query sub-slot.
Allow the condition to pass when the current effect entity has not yet carried the TriggeredThisGame flag.
block.OncePerTurnCondition.title: 🟣 Limit: Once per turn
editor.skill_help.block.once_per_turn_co: 3 instances: 180 Crazy Chemist, 408 Halloween Expert, 511 Space Ninja; 511 also depends on environment and other complete external conditions.

This is the native triggered marker guard, the evaluator itself does not clear or write markers; it cannot be used to automatically add full counts/reset logic to any effect. Pending verification: the specific system for marker writing and turn cleanup, shared groups and cross-form retention still need verification; cannot guarantee each new group is independent.
Skill group root Condition; no parameters, no child slots.
Allow the condition to pass when the current effect entity does not yet have the TriggeredThisTurn marker.
editor.skill_blocks.labels.entry: Condition: lane has a specified property
editor.skill_blocks.labels.entry_3: Matches entities with a position component whose lane has the specified native component. Graveyard is a lane ability, separate from the entity's Gravestone state or play-as-Gravestone ability.
editor.skill_blocks.labels.entry_4: OnTerrainQueryEvaluator.Matches 0x225C438 looks up lane entities with LaneElement.LaneIds and checks their TerrainType component. A persistent group on vanilla card 539 grants Graveyard to the lane. Card 252 excludes the lane using this condition. This is static native evidence; combinations require separate engine verification.
editor.skill_help.block.on_terrain_query: Original 252 Confused Graverobber uses Not(OnTerrainQuery Graveyard); 539 Graveyard Environment's persistent group grants Graveyard to the lane it is on.

Although the field name is called TerrainType, it actually checks more than just the normal terrain interface. Original Graveyard Environment grants the Graveyard ability to the lane; this is not equivalent to the candidate's FaceDown tombstone state or the PlaysFaceDown tombstone card ability.
Query slot; native traversal of candidate LaneElement's lane ID, then checking the lane entity's component.
Check if the lane the candidate is on has the specified component.
editor.skill_help.parameter_help.text_18: The component type to check on the entity where the candidate is located; not checking the candidate itself. Grass/Water/Highground are normal terrain components; the original graveyard environment grants the Graveyard ability to the lane, which is different from FaceDown or PlaysFaceDown.
editor.skill_help.parameter_help.text_2: This author parameter maps to OnTerrainQuery: check the component of the lane where the candidate is located, not the candidate itself. Graveyard is the ability granted to the lane by the original graveyard environment, different from FaceDown and PlaysFaceDown; it does not limit the expression of not adding this condition.
block.OpenLaneQuery.title: 🔵 Query: Open lane
82 Dance Poppy uses Plants/true; 476 Light Wind uses Zombies/false; 547 High Platform Diving Zombie first filters water routes, then judges position with Zombies/false. Original 61 only shows three combinations of Plants true/false and Zombies false.

It is not considered empty if neither side has units, nor if there is no environment. Only check the units list in the Lane for the player matching PlayerFactionType; units from the other faction and EnvironmentId are not involved in this judgment. Pass if there is no corresponding player entry; if found, must have exactly one unit, and that unit has a valid Teamup or IsForTeamupCard=true to pass. Two or more do not pass; an already registered empty list with anomalies will not automatically pass as 0. This condition does not include aquatic, terrain, or full card legality. Pending verification: original cards with Zombies/true have no instances; multi-player same faction, special route placeholders, and all terrain/placement rules are not executed. This can be used without equal to the final certain placement success.
Query slot; candidates must have a Lane component, original examples used for generating, moving, or route judgment in conditions.
Check if the candidate route can still accommodate one unit for the explicitly specified faction, and handle the single placeholder according to the team-up rules.
editor.skill_help.parameter.open_lane_qu: Clearly check the position of plants or zombies faction, not automatically become friendly or enemy based on current author/source.
Indicates positioning for teamable units, will not grant Teamup to new units. When false, existing units with valid Teamup can still pass through.
block.OriginalTargetCardGuidQuery.title: 🔵 Object: Original target card
editor.skill_help.block.original_target_: The complete transformation formula of the original 599 Mimic Actor; missing keys use native default -1, valid card numbers only participate in matching.

The comparison is based on the card template GUID, which can match multiple copies of the same card, not the unique entity ID; the context needs to have saved the original number, and cannot assume that any transformation target can be tracked based on the name.
Match the card with the original card number retained in the current context.
block.PersistsAfterTransform.title: 🟣 Limit: Persists after transform
editor.skill_help.block.persists_after_t: 440 Regenerate on the original group marked with Deform and +1/+1 descriptor; 637 Fig in itself ends the deformation group mark. Both original cards only have this group, and do not provide the original example of 'marking a group to automatically retain associated auxiliary groups'.

TransformCard first calls ResetWithoutRecord, then ExtractPermanentEffectEntities checks each old EffectEntities for PersistsAfterTransform. The extractor only selects and removes from the destruction list based on each effect entity's own mark, not automatically retaining other groups by AbilityGroupId. It also does not expand along Herald associations into closures. Then destroy remaining old effects, remove and load the card component, and finally append the retained ID. Cannot claim that all attributes, costs, keywords, or skills are retained. To be verified: The selection process does not read AbilityGroupId, which does not represent that all persistent modifiers ignore it; shared IDs may still affect other systems, and cannot prove that cross-formula collisions have no impact. The partial retention with Herald does not have evidence of automatic closure; the interaction between reload definitions and retained entities, existing granted abilities reset/remove, and complete state after any transformation still need independent verification and engine approval.
Native skill group root mark; 440 and 637 are placed in the deformation group that needs to continue existing. No parameters, no sub-slots. It is not a regular true/false condition evaluator.
Mark the effect entity where it is located as a deformation to retain the old skill fragment; after the new card type is loaded, append the retained old effect entity ID to the new skill list.
block.PlayerInfoCondition.title: 🟡 Player info condition
editor.skill_help.block.player_info_cond: 124 Tangleweed finds the Plants player and compares SunCounter; 452 Snake Grass finds the Plants player and compares TurnCounter.

Faction is a clear Plants/Zombie camp, not automatically interpreted based on source. Query candidates are changed to this player, original Self/Source/Target context remains. Pending verification: multi-player special mode's first player selection and faction absence path not verified in engine.
Skill group Filter component; Query usually checks the player's resources, turn count or block component.
Find the specified Faction player/hero, then apply Query to this player entity.
editor.skill_help.parameter.player_info_: Clearly select player faction. Native FindFirstPlayerOfFaction returns the first player of this faction.
Query the selected player, cannot treat missing unit-specific component as value 0.
block.PrimaryTargetFilter.title: 🟠 Primary target filter
editor.skill_help.block.primary_target_f: Original 3 Konga Dance Zombie hand-select; 136 Toxic Spore randomly selects 1 target; 262 Sheep Transformation selects the highest attack, 263 Shrink Spell selects the lowest health; 102 Cherry Bomb processes targets on both lanes and additional objects; 661 Spring Mustache, 677 Zombie Morgue only affect additional objects.

All does not limit by NumTargets; Random removes candidates randomly to the specified number, Random's 0 deletes all, cannot treat All/Manual original card's 0 as no target. Sorted and direction valid only retain the highest/lowest tied extremes, not just change display order. AdditionalTargetType enabled, for each selected main target, run AdditionalTargetQuery with it as new context.TargetId; OnlyApply true only generates effect on additional targets, false includes main target. If AdditionalTarget is not enabled, this switch does not cancel normal main target effect. Pending verification: hand-select blocking/canceling, repeated additional results, effect consumption after target invalidation and all settlement timing sequence not verified in original engine; cannot treat additional targets as Secondary secondary targets.
Skill group root target filtering component; Query filters actual effect objects, not equal to trigger target/source filtering.
Determine the main target candidates for the effect and prepare effect objects according to selection, extreme range or additional target rules.
editor.skill_help.parameter.primary_targ: All retains current candidates; Random reduces by NumTargets; Manual enters native hand selection judgment, not pop up by title or Query itself. Hand selection interface/cancel timing still pending native engine verification.

Only serves as upper limit of retained quantity in already verified random selector: insufficient retains existing, 0 will delete all; All and Manual original examples save large number of 0 but do not indicate no target. Negative numbers have no safe meaning.
All does not narrow extreme values; Sorted combined with attributes and directions, only retains all tied candidates with highest/lowest, then continues selection.
Attack uses injected attack calculator, Health uses current health calculator; None value is 0. It is not a manually filled threshold, also does not automatically select the hero with most health.
Lowest Lowest, Highest Highest; None or insufficient candidates less than 2 do not narrow. Keep tied objects by extremes, quantity then handled by SelectionType.
None only uses the normal main target; Query enables additional query paths, must be paired with AdditionalTargetQuery. Additional is not SecondaryTargetId.
Only effective when Additional Target mode is enabled: true only processes additional, false processes both main targets; mode None still normally processes main targets.
Candidate query for the actual effect character; does not replace trigger source/target conditions, nor automatically fill survival, faction or legal position.

Each selected main target becomes a new context.TargetId, itself established by the effect entity, then check additional objects; original event Source reusability and all additional fields are not covered by this path.
block.QueryEntityCondition.title: 🟡 Entity condition (QueryEntityCondition)
editor.skill_help.block.query_entity_con: 515 Celestial Wizard uses Any to check if there are adjacent zombies; 476 Light Wind uses All to check if the found ones meet the route conditions.

All requires that each found entity meets the condition, Any requires at least one to meet it; when the result is empty, native All is true and Any is false. When checking each candidate, the original context is retained, and Self is not automatically replaced with this candidate. To be verified: The entities visible to EntityFinder depend on its model and query; invalid/null sub-queries and any combinations are not executed.
Skill Group Filter component; Finder and Query are query sub-slots, not effect lists or repeated resolution counts.
First use Finder to find a batch of entities, then apply Query to each of them to get the condition result for the entire skill group using All or Any.
editor.skill_help.parameter.query_entity: First determine the set of entities to check, native EntityFinder.FindEntities(Finder,context).
Judge on each candidate found by Finder; do not treat Finder itself as a sub-slot judgment.
All all satisfied/Any any satisfied; empty set rules differ, cannot say both are 'failed if not found'.

editor.skill_help.block.same_faction_que: Vanilla Template 668 has a complete original group, prefabName is empty and there is no corresponding Chinese original text; Self baseline has another native static basis.

block.SameLaneAsTargetQuery.title: 🔵 Range: Same lane as target
editor.skill_help.block.same_lane_as_tar: Vanilla 65 Deep Sea Golem, 97 Double Mushroom's complete route selection recipe.
This query matches a route, not comparing the position lists of any two units; nor is it detecting the EnvironmentId of the target. The context target needs to be a unit on the corresponding route.

Match route entity containing the current TargetId unit.

Vanilla 82 Dance Poppy used to select self and adjacent lanes; 111 Abundant Corn Horn used in complete generation recipe.

Not a general judgment of whether two units are on the same lane. Native checks the unit/environment on the lane; when self is in InLimbo transition state, it can also query the previous position. Do not replace other same lane queries with name-based ones.

Match the route entity where self is located.
block.SecondaryTargetFilter.title: 🎯 Secondary target filter
editor.skill_help.block.secondary_target: Original 27 takes you flying, 57 scares with manual target selection; 65 Deep Sea Zombie's secondary target group; 103 Magic Bean Vine uses random target selection. All effects within the original group must be included without omission.

It is not a reapplication of the primary target damage, nor is it an additional target of Primary. For moving original recipes, select the moved unit as the primary target and the target path as the secondary target; All/Random/Manual are handled by the original secondary target process. Manual selection may also enter the selection when there are allied units. 35 original secondary targets all use range All, sorting None, and additional None; inherited Sorted/Additional fields still retain original values. This time, there is no proof that they are effective in the secondary target channel, so they cannot be copied as promises of all primary target options. Pending verification: How each effect consumes secondary targets, manual selection cancellation, no target path, multiple target competition, and failure during resolution are not executed in the original engine.
Secondary target component of the skill group root; Query selects secondary target candidates, which must be compatible with specific consumers and the primary target.
Determine the second target role for effects that support secondary targets; the primary target and secondary target are separately saved in Effect.TargetId and Effect.SecondaryTargetId.
editor.skill_help.parameter.secondary_ta: All retain current candidates; Random reduce by NumTargets; Manual enter native hand selection judgment, not pop up by title or Query itself. Hand selection interface/cancel timing still pending original engine verification.

Only serves as a retention quantity upper limit in already verified random selectors: insufficient retain existing, 0 will delete all; All and Manual original examples save large number of 0 but do not indicate no target. Negative numbers have no safe meaning.
Inherited field; 35 original secondary targets are all All. This time no proof of secondary targets Sorted general consumption, cannot only commit effect by editable enumeration.
Inherited field; original secondary targets are all None, secondary target extreme values reading not proved by this batch.
Inherit field; original secondary targets are all None, do not treat direction tags as validated secondary targets rule.

Inherit field; original secondary targets are all None, this batch has not verified the general secondary target additional query consumers. Keep unknown original value, do not promise to be the same as Primary.
Inherit field; this batch only confirms Primary consumers read this switch, cannot claim to change effect range by checking on Secondary.

editor.skill_help.block.self_entity_filt: 61 Cat Lady checks its WillTriggerEffects and IsAlive; 65 Deep Sea Zombie's original group also uses the same filtering structure.

Original binding SelfEntityFilter→SelfEntityProvider; it is not using the current source SourceId or the triggered target TargetId as the self. The original context is passed as is to Query; if the Self entity is not found, this evaluator directly returns false. Pending verification: The setting of SelfId in various triggers/associated abilities needs to be verified against the complete original group context, and Self should not be permanently equated with the initial card that can be played.
Skill group Filter component, Query is the query sub-slot; separated from the selection of the final effect target, PrimaryTarget.

editor.skill_help.parameter.self_entity_: Conditional judgment on SelfId entity; does not represent execution of this query matching all objects.

block.SubsetQuery.title: 🔵 Query: In subset/tag
block.SubsetQuery.param.Subset.title: Subset / tag
editor.skill_help.block.subset_query.exa: 199 King Zombie checks the knightofthelivingdead tag, 214 Zombie Yeti checks yetilunchbox, 262 Goat Transformation checks goat; the contract lists all 16 actual tags and their native card type matches/non-matches sources, without treating old tags from the original pack as valid card pools.
editor.skill_help.block.subset_query.lim: The Subset field is not a card GUID, tribe ID, file path, or a single registered card pool name; here it calls Tags.HasTag → List<string>.Contains. It does not automatically traverse the entire card database, nor does it return all candidates. The full database source is provided by the outer CardFromSubsetFinder → CardDatabase.FindEntities, and there may be other queries and placement restrictions afterward. Pending verification: This batch does not prove that any database lifecycle candidate can be created by all effects; registering new cards, future tags, random selection/placement, and local Finder visibility range still need to be verified by outer functions.

editor.skill_help.parameter.subset_query: Match with string members in original native Tags list; preserve original case and space, do not automatically convert Chinese card name, author info tags or tribe names into runtime tags. block.SubtypeQuery.title: 🔵 Query: Subtype match
block.SubtypeQuery.param.Subtype.title: Subtype
editor.skill_help.block.subtype_query.ex: 57 Threat filters monsters with 39, 61 Cat Lady filters pets with 10, 64 Come On filters food with 18; 65 Deep Sea Giant Zombie's native list [11,39], 452 Snake Grass [28,22] provide multiple tribe storage examples.

Custom tribe name data and native numeric registration still follow existing contracts, do not claim to create new tribes just because query can write integer.

block.SunCostPlusNComparisonQuery.title: 🔵 Query: Cost + N comparison
editor.skill_help.block.sun_cost_plus_n_: 178 Wizard Zombie, 436 Molecular Plant, 503 Morph Station, 621 Leap Evolution, 637 Morph Fig all Equal/+1.

It does not modify the cost, nor does it directly generate/morph. Pending verification: whether any context provides correct TargetId, final payment discount rules, and integer extreme combinations are not executed; only the original 5 examples provide +1/Equal examples.
Query slot, original 5 examples are all located in the SubsetQuery combination of the morph descriptor; target selection and card type filtering are separated.

editor.skill_help.parameter.sun_cost_plu: Signed offset N; formula is candidateCost compared to (contextTargetCost + N), not adding N to the current candidate and then comparing.

block.SunCounterComparisonQuery.title: 🔵 Query: Sun counter comparison
editor.skill_help.block.sun_counter_comp: 124 Morning Glory, 148 Green Leaf Sage, 300 Water Balloon, 467 Apple Flying Disc all compare >= 6, all original texts relate to sun collected this turn.

AmountUsed is not subtracted here, so it's not the current available resources or the amount of a single resource effect. False when there's no SunCounter, and it's not treated as 0. Pending verification: The update range of Amount across all phases interacts with the extended resource retention, which is not executed in this batch engine; this query itself does not record resources.
Query slot; the original example checks Plants players on PlayerInfoCondition.Query.
Read the current modifiable total value of the candidate SunCounter.Amount, then compare it with the threshold using the comparison symbol.
editor.skill_help.parameter.sun_counter_: Candidate total value on the left, compared to SunCounterValue using Equal/<=/>=.
Total resource count threshold; do not write "at least N sun remaining".
block.TargetableInPlayFighterQuery.title: 🔵 Query: Targetable fighter in play
editor.skill_help.block.targetable_in_pl: Original 1 Avocado, 3 Conga Zombie, etc., 358 target conditions.
